author: UraniumNinja
body:
Name: UraniumNinja

In January, I began playing on the Avicus Network a bit

One of my friends came over to my house and we only had one computer so I let him play while I use my phone

I set him op on this network and he begins playing skywars

about 1 hour later he comes to me and sais he cant connect

I go over and check and it sais I've been ban, no reason or anything

Sorry for the inconvenience but its your choice if I'm allowed on the server or not  

Thank you and have a wonderful day!
